original_description: Assemble your images, muted video clips, voice-over and timed captions into an MP4 using your existing SamAutomation account. Check a render plan, confirm its account usage, then retrieve the completed video. Up to six clips and 60 seconds per render. Source files must be direct public HTTPS media links. Results have shareable URLs. Existing completion or failure email notifications may apply. No AI generation, purchases or subscription changes.
summary_ja: 画像・動画・ナレーション・字幕をMP4にまとめる。
limitations: 既存アカウントと公開HTTPSの直接メディアリンクが必要。
1回のレンダリングは最大6クリップ・60秒。生成物は共有可能なURLを持つ。
実動作・料金・一覧本体との照合は未検証。
